display_information.name: SchemaLens
display_information.description: Get schema diff reports and breaking change alerts directly in Slack.
display_information.long_description: SchemaLens compares SQL schemas and posts rich diff reports, migration SQL, and breaking change alerts to your Slack workspace. Use the /schemalens slash command to diff schemas on demand, or connect SchemaLens CI/CD to get automatic alerts in any channel.

slash_commands.description: Diff two SQL schemas and post the report
